verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a regions feature that lets users deploy models in chosen locations explicitly to "meet data-residency needs." It also offers a US-only Serverless mode that serves inference exclusively from the US for compliance. However, the evidence covers where inference runs, not where stored data such as datasets, fine-tuning data, logs or weights resides. Missing for 10: documented region selection for stored data (datasets, training artifacts, logs), a list of available regions or how to select them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Fireworks runs a global fleet so you can deploy models close to users, meet data-residency needs, and scale across clouds.
US-only Serverless serves inference exclusively from the US, making it a good fit for compliance needs.
Multi-region deployments enable resilience to localized outages, maintaining application availability as workloads scale across regions.
